remarks: This delightful 3BR 2B unit in sought after Rowayton Woods gives new meaning to the term "updated"  Transformation might be the better word. In 2022 both bathrooms were totally redone. Since then heating, AC and water heater have all been replaced. New doors, moldings/baseboards, recessed lighting, custom closets, carpeting and fresh paint throughout can be added to the list. However, the drum roll worth addition has to be the top to bottom new kitchen. Custom cabinets with under cabinet lighting, quartz counter tops and backsplash, stainless steel appliances, sophisticated hardware and faucet and a stunning hardwood floor. This is an end unit which means tons of natural light. It's located on the pond so you might just see the swans when you get up in the morning and look out your bedroom window. From the window seat in the living room you can put your feet up, read a book and have a view of the community garden. Enjoy the amenities of pool and tennis as well as the convenience of nearby shopping in Rowayton, Darien and Norwalk. Plus there's a walking bridge that can get you to the train in about 15 minutes. What's not to Love!! Garage available for an additional $35,000.
